text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to bother you, but I can't seem
to figure
out this Umester thing that
everybody likes...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean Umasta! I'm happy to
help, but why
the sudden interest?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae told me that if I start using it,
then she
would "collab" with me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds fun! I'll tell you all I know,
but in
return you've gotta collab with me
too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I bet if the three of us did a collab
together, our
fan numbers would shoot
through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, wait a sec! Am I dreaming right
now?
Have I finally been transported to
a fantasy
realm?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(A collab between Acute, Falco, and
Tarumae
would be god-tier! Would the
globe even survive
being split in two
from the earth-shattering
cheers?)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So when it says "Live," I should be
singing? It
does sound like fun with the
two of you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's right! You can also look at
fan
questions come in, and answer 'em
on the spot!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Guahhh! This. Is. Amazing. To think that
the
ground we stand on is sacred turf!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I vow to remain healthy and happy until
that
auspicious day. That's a concert I
can't afford to
miss!)
